{"consolidated_memory":"ANALYTICS/ETL/ROLLUP.SQL - DOUBLE COUNTING ISSUES (Three Separate Incidents)

Common Pattern:
- File: analytics/etl/rollup.sql (analytics side)
- Symptom: double counting in daily rollup
- Signal: totals larger than source table
- Reproduction: rerun the rollup for a day already loaded
- Stack: SQL with covering check via rollup reconciliation check in CI

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-28]:
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #5318, branch fix/double-counting-1
- Result: error rate dropped from 4.0% to under 6 per 10,000

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-19]:
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #8617, branch fix/double-counting-2
- Result: throughput rose 52%, to 468 requests per second

INCIDENT 3 [2026-05-06]:
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #9497, branch fix/double-counting-3
- Result: flaky test went from 51 failures per 100 runs to zero"}
